summary: All previously blocked admin flows now verified with correct password RobAdmin2025!. Login shows success alert and FAB appears. Add-card modal has card-type-select with options 'Immagine' and 'Video YouTube'. Invalid YouTube URL 'https://example.com/abc' triggers [data-testid=youtube-url-error] with message 'Link YouTube non valido...' and no card is created. Valid URL 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ' creates a card with img.youtube.com thumbnail and .play-badge; modal closes. Rimuovi button triggers window.confirm ('Sei sicuro?') and deletes the card (badge count returns to 0). Production Firestore cleaned. About Me > Modifica About shows [data-testid=section-images-editor] with all 4 rows (intro, journey, curiosity, cta) each with 'Carica immagine' button; Annulla closes editor without saving. Logout removes FAB while grid still renders 26 images. All 5 requested admin scenarios PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: rob-portfolio.vue remains a monolithic single-file component (>2600 lines). Recommend splitting into Header, PortfolioGrid, Lightbox, AdminAddCardModal, AboutMe components.
Uses window.alert() for login success and window.confirm() for delete. Consider using existing sweetalert/toast library for a nicer UX.
Direct client-side writes to production Firestore rely entirely on Firestore security rules. Any admin session compromise mutates prod. Consider a backend proxy for admin writes.
FAB button has no data-testid (only class='fab'). Consider adding data-testid=add-card-fab for stable test hooks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 admin flows + previously verified 7 public flows)
